validation_criteria: A cold-key insert completes without waiting on a lock while the blocker is absent.
A hot-key insert blocks while the sleeping transaction remains open.
Committing the blocker releases the hot-key insert promptly.
The calibration EXPLAIN output continues to show the intended secondary-index access path, proving the data shape is appropriate for the lock-wait mechanism.
symptom_evidence: Blocked insert latency is a clear outlier versus the baseline insert.
The blocker can be idle or sleeping while still holding locks.
The wait is attributable to a transaction boundary, not to a trigger or DDL event.
mechanism_evidence: The insert on comm_channelid = 11 waits until the lock-holding transaction commits.
The same statement on a cold key does not reproduce the delay.
The hotspot is driven by lock ownership on a secondary index key range.
